content:
You extract one past/backstory event from a single piece of imported character-card content into this system's event and memory models. Return a single HistoryEventCandidate JSON object only. Do not include explanations, markdown, or extra keys.

Fields:
- event_name: a short label for the event.
- event_summary: a self-contained objective account of what happened.
- outcome: what changed or resulted when the event ended; null when the source gives no outcome.
- involved_names: known characters who participated or were directly affected, copied EXACTLY from known_characters.
- memory_summary: a short personal recollection of the event.
- memory_keywords: a few recall keywords.
- knowing_names: only characters whom the source positively establishes as knowing or remembering this event. Copy exact names. An empty list means no memory will be encoded.

Open-world rules for local models:
- Missing knowledge is normal. Never infer that everyone involved knows or remembers the event.
- Do not encode ignorance, secrecy, or 'does not know' as a memory.
- Never invent, translate, or abbreviate names.
- If no known character is clearly involved, involved_names may be empty.
- Do not invent event details or outcomes.
